name: agience-server-seraph
description: Guardian layer for the Agience platform: access control, audit trails, identity verification, policy compliance, and cryptographic artifact signing.

tools.name: complete_authorizer_bearer
tools.description: Complete a bearer-token-only authorization code exchange (no refresh token)

tools.name: resolve_llm_credentials
tools.description: Raises. No-models rule, universal and including BYOK: this platform hands out no model API keys

tools.name: provide_aws_credentials
tools.description: Decrypt and return AWS credentials for a credential artifact

tools.name: audit_access
tools.description: Query the access audit log for a resource

tools.name: check_permissions
tools.description: Check what a person or API key can access

tools.name: grant_access
tools.description: Grant access to a collection for a person or team

tools.name: verify_token
tools.description: Verify a JWT against the platform JWKS and return which class it is, plus claims

tools.name: enforce_policy
tools.description: Evaluate a request or card against active system policies

tools.name: check_compliance
tools.description: Check compliance of a resource or workflow against governance rules

tools.name: get_person_preferences
tools.description: Read the calling person's stored preferences from Origin

tools.name: set_person_preferences
tools.description: Update the calling person's preferences in Origin (shallow merge)

MANTLE_URI.description: Base URI of the Mantle backend

MCP_HOST.description: Bind host for the MCP server

MCP_PORT.description: HTTP port for the MCP server

ORIGIN_URI.description: Base URI of the identity authority — issuance only (OIDC, WebAuthn, JWKS, key custody). Read by the person-management tektons, which reach it over the wire; chorus imports origin zero times.

_env_note: AGIENCE_API_URI and AGIENCE_API_KEY were declared required here and are read NOWHERE in server.py (verified 2026-07-31). A deployer honouring this manifest set two dead variables and omitted MANTLE_URI, which then silently defaulted to localhost:8081. This note lives at TOP LEVEL, not inside config.env — a consumer iterating env would otherwise see a variable named '_removed'.
_tools_note: Generated from the @mcp.tool registrations in server.py on 2026-07-31. It previously advertised tools that do not exist and omitted tools that do; a client reads this array to discover the surface.
